title: Senior Test Engineer
description:
Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world leading MCUs, SoCs, Analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world’s leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you.
Renesas employs roughly 21,000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what’s next in electronics and the world.

This role is an experienced individual contributor position requiring solid hands-on expertise in ATE test development, product validation, and debugging. The candidate will contribute to the development of reliable and cost-effective test solutions, working closely with more senior engineers while progressively increasing autonomy on complex tasks. For this role you are expected to provide and own the schedule on problems of a diverse scope, with occasional guidance. 
Renesas Electronics, a leading global semiconductor company, is rapidly scaling investing in power delivery business. Products include Point of loads (POL), Hotswap/Efuse, drivers.
Key Responsibilities
- Develop and maintain ATE test programs and hardware for analog, mixed-signal, and power management products
- Execute test plan implementation, ensuring required test coverage and quality targets
- Support product bring-up, characterization, and validation activities
- Perform debug and failure analysis on ATE systems and bench setups
- Analyze test data to identify issues and improve yield and test stability
- Work closely with Design and Product Engineering teams to resolve technical problems
- Support production ramp and sustaining engineering activities
- Contribute to test time and cost optimization efforts
- Follow established DFT methodologies and test standards
Key Competencies
- Strong execution and hands-on approach
- Good problem-solving and debugging capability
- Ability to work in team environments with increasing autonomy
- Attention to detail and quality focus
- Willingness to learn and grow technically

- Bachelor’s degree in Electrical/Computer Engineering
- 3–6+ years of experience in test engineering or related field
- Experience with ATE platforms (COHU DMDX, STS8300 is a plus)
- Basic understanding of DFT concepts and production test flows
- Experience in debugging analog and mixed-signal circuits
- Familiarity with lab equipment (oscilloscope, multimeter, spectrum analyzer)
- Programming skills in C/C++, Python, or similar
- Basic knowledge of data analysis and statistical methods

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future.
At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives.
We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.
Are you ready to join our team and shape the future with us?
Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. For more information, please read our Diversity & Inclusion Statement.

title: Staff Quality Engineer- SDET
description:
Strength in Trust 

OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society. 

The Challenge

- We are looking for a staff level SDET to support our product development teams.

- As the Staff SDET, you will play a crucial role in shaping and leading our software testing strategy.

- You will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing robust test automation frameworks, mentoring a team of SDETs (Software Development Engineer in Test), and ensuring the overall quality and reliability of our software products.

Your Mission

As a Staff SDET, you will:

- Provide technical leadership and guidance to the SDET team.

- Collaborate with development and QE (Quality Engineering) teams to integrate testing into the software development process.

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable and efficient test automation frameworks and test architectures.

- Rub shoulders with developers in writing unit and integration tests using their tools and frameworks.

- Ensure the frameworks support various testing types, including functional, integration, and performance testing.

- Mentor and guide junior SDETs, providing technical expertise and career development support.

- Conduct training sessions to enhance the skills of the testing team.

- Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning within the team.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop comprehensive test plans.

- Execute and oversee the execution of test cases, ensuring thorough coverage of functional and non-functional requirements.

- Analyze test results and provide meaningful insights to improve product quality.

- Work closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and user stories.

- Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, providing clear updates on testing progress and issues.

- Add, maintain, and update scripts in existing automation suite, helping with running the suite across various checkpoints in the release cycle.

- Participate in various POCs (Proof of Concept) to keep the automation framework and technology relevant and current to product offerings.

- Conduct peer reviews of test code and automation frameworks.

You Are

- You are a seasoned SDET with an automate anything anywhere attitude who is looking for a challenging technical leadership role in a dynamic and innovative company.

- You can efficiently find the underlying cause of a failure (in an integrated environment) and alert the right team.

- You are consistently willing to pitch in to support a long running deployment, even after hours.

- You are willing to learn and pick up new skillsets to support the ever-changing technology landscape like Cloud computing & AI (Artificial Intelligence).

- You can understand complex product and deployment architectures and create efficient test solutions.

- You want to be part of a team that is passionate about delivering high-quality software solutions.

Your Experience Includes

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical or business field.

- 8+ years of relevant experience working as a developer, automation engineer or SDET.

- 8+ years of experience coding in Java and must have strong practical knowledge of OOPs and Core Java principles.

- 4+ years of experience contributing to Test-Driven Development or BDD (Behavior Driven Development) with tools like Cucumber, Junit, Mockito, or TestNG.

- 3+ years of experience with CI/CD tools like Jenkins, Circle CI, or Azure DevOps with the ability to create test pipelines using Java or Groovy.

- 4+ years of experience with Selenium or Cypress frameworks for automating GUI (User Interface) and E2E tests of the application.

- 4+ years of experience with REST Assured or similar tools like Postman for automating APIs.

- 4+ years of experience working in a highly automated CI/CD environment.

- 4+ years of experience with source control tools such as Bitbucket, GitHub or GitLab.

- 2+ years of experience mining meaningful logs for troubleshooting using tools like Splunk, Dynatrace or Coralogix.

- 3+ years of experience working in a cloud shop preferably Azure with exposure to various Azure services like Gateways, Redis, Storage, VMs (virtual machines) and Kubernetes clusters.

- 3+ years of experience in testing mobile applications, both native and websites using Appium on both real devices and simulators either in a private farm of 3rd party vendors like Sauce Labs or BrowserStack.

- 4+ years of experience working with geographically distributed teams in US, Canada, and India.

- Strong analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to work as part of a team, demonstrate initiative, solve problems independently and mentor others.

- Passion for high quality work and attention to detail.

- Strong oral and written communication skills.

Extra Awesome

- Prior exposure to AI/ML systems and how to use them in testing thus making test pipeline more intelligent.

- Experience in analyzing the CPU Utilization, Memory usage, Network usage, Garbage Collection and DB Parameters and DB Reports to verify the performance of the applications.

- Ability to spin up scalable test architecture using Docker or Kubernetes.

- Experience with Kubernetes and extended usage patterns for test grids, auto scale properties.

Where we Work

We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.

Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.

Benefits

As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.

Resources 

Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people: 

- OneTrust Careers on YouTube

- @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Your Data

You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview. You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.

Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse-mail.io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign.net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust.com.

Our Commitment to You 

When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career. 

OneTrust provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
description:
About Backbase Backbase powers the financial experiences of many of the world's leading banks. Our engagement banking platform helps banks unify customer data, orchestrate journeys, and deliver personalized experiences across digital channels. About the role We are building the Customer Lifetime Orchestrator — an omni-channel marketing and customer engagement platform that helps banks engage end customers and influence financial behaviour.

As Senior SDET, you own quality for this domain together with the engineering team: test strategy, automation completeness, and the team's ability to execute effectively. This is a hands-on test design and automation role — not a downstream QA handoff. You will partner with Product, UX, and full-stack engineers (web, mobile, backend, AI-assisted features) to shift quality left and scale automation.

What you will do

● Define and execute test strategy and test plans per release (scope, risks, schedule, entry/exit criteria).

● Co-author acceptance criteria and Gherkin scenarios with Product; act as quality gatekeeper before releases.

● Build and maintain Playwright web E2E tests for real-world customer journeys across engagement channels.

● Govern mobile E2E strategy (Android/iOS) with engineers; use device-farm/matrix testing. ● Integrate automated tests into CI/CD with GitHub Actions (smoke, regression, quality gates).

● Manage test environments with Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm.

● Use Grafana (or similar) to analyse test results and improve feedback loops.

● Combine automation with exploratory and manual testing for edge cases; reduce flakiness and improve parallelization.

● Coach engineers on TDD, BDD, contract tests, synthetic data, and shift-left practices. ● Advocate AI-assisted testing (generation, visual regression, maintenance).

What you bring Required

 ● 5+ years as SDET or hands-on QA with an automation-first mindset.

● Strong test planning and acceptance-criteria design with Product/UX.

● Playwright (web), Espresso (Android), XCUITest (iOS).

● Java and JavaScript/TypeScript; Angular SPA, mobile, microservices.

 ● API testing (REST, Postman, RestAssured or equivalent).

● CI/CD (GitHub Actions/Jenkins), BDD/Gherkin, web and mobile E2E.

● Cloud platforms (preferably Azure) and Docker/Kubernetes.

● Device/browser farms (Sauce Labs, BrowserStack, or equivalent).

● Git/GitHub, Atlassian tools (Jira, Confluence).

● Non-functional testing (performance, security, accessibility, localization).

 ● Excellent communication in distributed teams (India, Vietnam, Europe).

Nice to have

● Digital banking, martech, or campaign/engagement management.

● Performance testing (k6, Gatling, JMeter).

● SaaS or enterprise software testing experience.

● AI/ML product testing; XRay, CucumberStudio, SonarCloud, security tooling.

What we offer

 ● Premium customer-facing platform used by leading banks worldwide.

● Shape quality engineering across web, mobile, backend, and AI orchestration.

● Global, distributed team with core hours in India and overlap with Europe.

title: Senior Performance Test Automation Engineer - Assistant Vice President
description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

**Role Overview**
=================

We are looking for a Senior Performance Test Engineer with strong hands-on automation skills. The role is a blend of performance engineering (about 60%) and test automation (about 40%).

You will own the performance testing lifecycle for business-critical applications. This covers workload modelling, test execution, bottleneck analysis and reporting. You will also build and maintain automation frameworks and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines. You will work with developers, architects and DevOps teams to make sure applications meet performance, scalability and resilience targets.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Performance Testing**
-----------------------

* Define the performance test strategy, plan and approach for applications and releases.

* Derive workload models from production data and business volumes, and define NFRs/SLAs (response time percentiles, throughput, error rate, resource utilization).

* Design, script and execute load, stress, soak, spike, scalability and breakpoint tests.

* Monitor applications and infrastructure with APM and observability tools. Identify bottlenecks across the application, database, middleware and infrastructure layers.

* Analyze thread dumps, heap dumps, GC logs and slow queries, and recommend tuning.

* Prepare clear performance test reports with findings, trends, risks and go/no-go recommendations.

* Review and baseline results across releases and track performance regressions.

* Provide guidance on capacity, scalability and resilience (autoscaling, failover and caching).

**Test Automation**
-------------------

* Design, build and maintain scalable automation frameworks for API and, where needed, UI testing.

* Develop automated regression suites and reusable test components with good coding practices.

* Integrate automated functional and performance tests into CI/CD pipelines with pass/fail quality gates.

* Enable shift-left performance testing (component-level and API-level checks in the pipeline).

* Manage test code in Git with branching, pull requests and peer reviews.

* Build dashboards and automated reports for test results and trends.

* Contribute to test data automation and environment readiness checks.

**Leadership and Collaboration**
--------------------------------

* Act as the technical lead for performance and automation in the team. Mentor junior engineers and review scripts and frameworks.

* Work in Agile/Scrum teams, estimate effort and track work in Jira.

* Present results and risks to technical and business stakeholders.

* Define and promote testing standards and best practices.

**Mandatory Skills**
====================

**Performance Testing (Primary)**
---------------------------------

* 7+ years of hands-on performance testing and engineering experience.

* Strong command of performance testing concepts: workload modelling, think time, pacing, concurrency, percentiles and Little's Law.

* Expert in **Apache JMeter and/or LoadRunner** (scripting, correlation, parameterization, distributed execution, analysis).

* Experience with at least one APM or observability tool: **Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Grafana/Prometheus, Splunk or ELK**.

* Proven bottleneck analysis skills: JVM and GC tuning, thread and connection pools, DB query tuning, CPU/memory/I/O analysis.

* Strong knowledge of HTTP/HTTPS, REST and SOAP, and of authentication mechanisms (OAuth2, JWT, SSO).

* Good understanding of microservices, distributed systems, caching and load balancing.

* Good SQL skills, with experience in at least one RDBMS (Oracle, PostgreSQL or SQL Server).

**Test Automation (Secondary)**
